column1: # The grid (suprema per combination of hardware and launch settings, not per file):
# vCPU × memory × disk (the VM disk capped at 120 MB/s, or /tmp on a 1 GiB tmpfs) × pool size, under a closed
# load of pool + 2 clients, for each of the two workloads installations send: text reports (2, 5, 20 pages) and
# text with 30-60 pictures (10-15 MB). Each cell's supremum: its saturation throughput, the latency at it, and
# whether it held (no OOM kill, no 5xx). 132 cells, about 13 h a replicate: --reps 1, then repeat around the
# boundaries. Needs a VM of 8 cpus.
